planning_notes: Original requirement: D6 buzzer sounds every 2 seconds for 200 ms; timing logic belongs in the SysML model using elapsed_ms delta updates. This proposal only allocates the required actuator port and the required time base.

A specific tone frequency was not provided in the requirements; tone_output initial is set to 31 Hz (catalog-valid low value) as a placeholder. The model is expected to set/enable the actual required frequency and duration using elapsed_ms.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer drive (model controls frequency and gating for 2s/200ms pattern using elapsed_ms)
